summary: League of Legends entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: League of Legends

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.version: Current League of Legends Windows client
primary.why: Riot's official download page provides Windows and Mac clients, and the Windows route is the safest capture/performance path for the live Summoner's Rift/ARAM service.
primary.how_to_play: Install the current Riot client on Windows, capture the live patch being played, and record the patch/date because champions, modes, items, and balance change over time.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service champion roster, modes, map variants, and balance change by patch; record the exact patch/date for any archive capture.

entries.title: League of Legends: Wild Rift
entries.definitive_edition: Current Wild Rift mobile client with patch/season/region documented

emulation.emulator: Android emulator only if supported and compliant with current service rules
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official iOS/Android client on real hardware

primary.version: Current live Wild Rift mobile client
primary.why: Wild Rift is a separate mobile MOBA built for touch controls rather than a port of the PC League client. The live mobile client is the archive route, and champion roster, ranked seasons, events, monetization, and regional server state must be documented at capture time.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current iOS or Android client. Record app version, region/server, account state, season/patch, champion/skin availability, input device, ranked/event state, network conditions, and whether the PC League of Legends entry was only referenced for comparison.

secondary.why: Phone iOS/Android remains the main mobile target.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with the PC League of Legends entry; Wild Rift is a distinct mobile game.

entries.title: Legends of Runeterra
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows client with patch/account state documented

emulation.emulator: Android emulator only if supported and compliant with current service rules
emulation.notes: Prefer native Windows for archive capture and real mobile hardware for mobile comparison.

primary.version: Current Legends of Runeterra Windows/Riot client
primary.why: Legends of Runeterra is a live digital card game in the League of Legends universe. Windows is the best capture route; mobile availability is current, and the live-service focus has shifted toward The Path of Champions.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows client. Record patch/date, Riot account/region, collection state, Path of Champions progress, PvP/ranked availability, decklist, monetization/loot-box state, and whether iOS/Android was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for mobile UI, touch controls, and account synchronization comparison.
secondary.why: Mobile is official and current, but PC is easier to capture cleanly.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with League of Legends or Wild Rift completion notes; this is a separate card/roguelite live service.
